name: guitar
description: v5: six black-coated strings (the striker, flush with the contact face, flash on hit) over a sunburst guitar body seen face-on behind the marble plane - lower and upper bouts with cream binding, waist, dark sound hole with rosette, rosewood bridge with bone saddle and nut - plus a rosewood fingerboard neck with frets and a headstock with six tuning pegs.

contact.note: marble centre at hit = point + normal*R
